what: Inside a long stretched track, a silhouette-shaped hole (CSS mask) is cut in the screen-pinned plate. After the track head touches the top of the screen, over 0.9 screens the hole grows 0 → 88.5vh so the silhouette (bottle, logo) becomes crisp. It holds for 0.2 screen, then over 1.1 screens grows to 2000vh so the whole plate opens. Both tempos are cubic in-out and bound to scroll. The ghost image layered inside the hole grows with the hole during the first tempo and fades in, then switches off at the hold moment, handing over to the plate’s first section. At 991px and below or with reduced motion, it is left open with no hole.

options.mid: Hole size at end of first beat, default 88.5
options.end: Hole size when fully open, default 2000
options.grow: First beat length (multiple of screen height), default .9 — 0 goes straight to mid from the start
options.narrow: At or below this width (px) it stays solid, without holes, default 991
options.--fx-shape: Hole shape (mask image — url(…svg) or gradient), default rounded hole
options.--fx-track: Track height, default 400vh — the length the panels stay stuck. Longer than the grow+hold+open screens
options.--fx-ghost-ratio: Width:height ratio of the stacked image, default 1
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Panel attached to the screen — put the content to be seen through the hole
options.[data-fx-part=ghost]: (optional) graphic that grows with the hole on the first beat

from.where: index.html .reveal (white sheet that opens through a bottle-shaped hole — mask calculation in index.js). Original values as is: mid 88.5 · end 2000 · grow .9 · hold .2 · open 1.1
